_note: Synthetic data created for this prototype. All ticket text, labels and resolution codes are generated, not taken from a real ITSM system.

tickets.title: VPN login fails with certificate expired error
tickets.description: User cannot connect to GlobalProtect VPN from a managed laptop. The client shows error GP-4012 and says the client certificate has expired.
tickets.symptoms: Error GP-4012 on connect; other users on the same gateway are fine.
tickets.resolution_notes: The client certificate profile had expired. Re-issued the certificate profile from the VPN portal and asked the user to reconnect, which restored access.

tickets.title: GlobalProtect VPN rejects user with GP-4012
tickets.description: Remote employee is unable to connect to the corporate VPN. GlobalProtect reports error GP-4012 for an expired client certificate after the laptop was away from the office for months.
tickets.symptoms: VPN connection drops immediately with GP-4012.
tickets.resolution_notes: Certificate auto-renewal had not run while the laptop was offline. Re-issued the certificate profile and confirmed the VPN connection succeeded.

tickets.title: VPN connection refused after password change
tickets.description: User changed their domain password this morning and VPN login is now refused. The client reports invalid credentials, not a certificate problem.
tickets.symptoms: Invalid credentials message at the VPN prompt.
tickets.resolution_notes: The saved credential in the VPN client was stale. Cleared the cached credentials and signed in with the new password.

tickets.title: VPN certificate error for finance users
tickets.description: Several finance users report GlobalProtect VPN error GP-4012 and an expired client certificate since this morning.
tickets.symptoms: GP-4012 for several users in the same department.

tickets.title: SAP payroll batch job times out at month end
tickets.description: The SAP payroll posting batch times out after 60 minutes during month-end processing. The job log shows long waits on the ledger table.
tickets.symptoms: Batch ZPAY_POST ends with TIME_OUT; database wait events on the ledger table.
tickets.resolution_notes: A missing index on the ledger table caused full scans. Added the index during the maintenance window and the batch completed in 12 minutes.

tickets.title: SAP payroll batch timeout during posting
tickets.description: Payroll posting batch ZPAY_POST in SAP fails with TIME_OUT at month end. The background job waits on the database for most of its runtime.
tickets.symptoms: TIME_OUT in the job log for ZPAY_POST.
tickets.resolution_notes: The work process time limit was too low for the data volume. Increased the batch time limit profile parameter and reran the job successfully.

tickets.title: Payroll job ZPAY_POST slow and timing out
tickets.description: ZPAY_POST batch in SAP is running far longer than usual at month end and then ends with TIME_OUT.
tickets.resolution_notes: Blocking locks from a parallel reconciliation job stalled posting. Rescheduled the reconciliation job outside the payroll window.

tickets.title: Outlook mailbox full and cannot send email
tickets.description: User receives a mailbox quota exceeded warning in Outlook and outgoing email stays in the outbox.
tickets.symptoms: Mailbox quota exceeded warning; messages stuck in the outbox.
tickets.resolution_notes: Mailbox had reached its 50 GB quota. Enabled the online archive and moved older items into it, after which sending resumed.

tickets.title: Mailbox quota exceeded for sales user
tickets.description: Sales user sees mailbox quota exceeded in Outlook and can no longer send email to customers.
tickets.symptoms: Quota exceeded banner and failed sends.
tickets.resolution_notes: Enabled the online archive for the user and applied the default retention policy to move older mail out of the primary mailbox.

tickets.title: Single sign-on loop on HR portal
tickets.description: Users are redirected repeatedly between the HR portal and the identity provider and never reach the application after the SAML certificate rollover.
tickets.symptoms: Browser redirect loop; SAML signature validation error in the application log.
tickets.resolution_notes: The HR portal still trusted the old SAML signing certificate. Uploaded the new certificate to the application's trust store and restarted the service.

tickets.title: HR portal SAML redirect loop after certificate rollover
tickets.description: HR portal login loops between the application and the identity provider. The log shows a SAML signature validation error since the certificate rollover.
tickets.symptoms: Redirect loop and SAML signature validation error.
tickets.resolution_notes: Imported the new identity provider signing certificate into the staging trust store and restarted the service to clear the loop.

tickets.title: Database server disk full on reporting cluster
tickets.description: Disk usage reached 100 percent on the reporting database server and the reporting service stopped writing data.
tickets.symptoms: No space left on device in the database log.
tickets.resolution_notes: Archived logs had filled the data volume. Cleaned up archived logs past retention and expanded the volume by 200 GB.

tickets.title: Payroll administrator account compromise investigation
tickets.description: Security investigation of suspicious logins to a payroll administrator account from an unrecognised location.
tickets.symptoms: Impossible travel alert for a privileged account.
tickets.resolution_notes: Confidential: credentials rotated and the session revoked under the incident response plan. Details are held by Security Operations.
